asked: Given a user views the product catalogue, they can see high-quality photos of the ceramic items.
tests: tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › the admin creates a product with an image
tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › the admin adds a product with an https image URL; shoppers find it by its description
planCriteria.criterion: The admin creates a product with an image

asked: Given a user views a mug, they can select from three distinct colours, each displaying its specific price and stock level.
Given a user adds a specific colour of mug to the cart, the cart correctly reflects that unique SKU.
tests: tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › the admin adds options with their own SKU, price and stock
planCriteria.criterion: The admin adds options with their own SKU, price and stock

asked: Given a user enters a valid discount code before the expiry date, the total price is reduced accordingly.
tests: tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › uses a discount code: applied on the server, counted once on payment, then used up
tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › the admin creates a one-use discount code
tests/unit/shop.test.ts › refuses inactive, expired, used-up and below-minimum codes
planCriteria.criterion: Uses a discount code: applied on the server, counted once on payment, then used up

asked: Given a user enters an expired discount code, the system rejects the code and applies no discount.
tests: tests/unit/shop.test.ts › refuses inactive, expired, used-up and below-minimum codes
planCriteria.criterion: Inactive, expired, used-up and below-minimum codes are refused

asked: Given a user completes a purchase via Stripe Checkout, the payment is processed successfully.
tests: tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › a shopper pays with Stripe Checkout at server-computed amounts; the signed webhook marks the order paid, decrements each product's stock and logs the confirmation email
tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › rejects webhooks without a valid signature
planCriteria.criterion: A shopper pays with Stripe Checkout at server-computed amounts; the signed webhook marks the order paid
Given a successful payment, the system sends an order confirmation email to the user's provided address.
Given a successful sale, the stock count for the specific SKU is automatically decremented by the quantity purchased.

asked: Given an admin user logs into the admin panel, they can create, update, or delete product entries.
tests: tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › the owner accesses the admin area, creates a product, reads it in the list, edits its details (price) and deletes (hides) it; the public catalogue follows at once
planCriteria.criterion: The owner accesses the admin area, creates a product, reads it in the list, edits its details (price) and deletes (hides) it

asked: Given an admin user accesses the admin panel, they can view a list of all historical orders.
tests: tests/e2e/shop.spec.ts › the owner accesses the admin area and sees the list of all orders with their payment status
planCriteria.criterion: The owner accesses the admin area and sees the list of all orders with their payment status
